name: Resistance Mastery (Item Mastery, Mythic)
body:
You become quicker at extracting extra power from your armor.

Prerequisite(s): Resistance Mastery.

Benefit(s): You only need a standard action to gain the bonus from Resistance Mastery. If you take 10 minutes to meditate, you can double the saving throw bonus or the energy resistance gained. You can also apply every 5 extra points of energy resistance to a different type of energy rather than using it all against one type only.
